_about: Elected officials who represent Bay View (Ben, Nov. 17, 2026). The daily run checks their websites, news pages and social accounts for Bay View news. 'covers' comes from the city's election_geography map service, checked against every directory address on Nov. 17, 2026. 'confirmed' accounts were checked on the account itself (Facebook page intro or Instagram bio names the office); 'unconfirmed' ones match by name only.

officials.name: Marina Dimitrijevic
officials.newsletter: Monthly e-news PDFs on her district page; sign up at https://city.milwaukee.gov/enotify
officials.notes: Instagram @marinaformke is her campaign account but posts as the alderwoman. Her e-news mentions @AlderMarina14 without naming the platform; not found on Instagram.

officials.name: Jack Eckblad
officials.notes: Only a campaign Facebook page found (confirmed: 'for Milwaukee County Board Supervisor District 4'). Instagram @jackeckblad exists but has 5 posts and no office in the bio.

officials.name: Megan O'Halloran
officials.district: Milwaukee Board of School Directors District 8
officials.notes: Seat is on the April 2027 ballot. MPS board URL not verified.

officials.name: Ryan Clancy
officials.covers: most of Bay View (north and central)

officials.name: Christine Sinicki
officials.covers: southeast Bay View (along KK and Chase south of about Oklahoma)
officials.notes: Re-elected Nov. 3, 2026. Her Facebook page says she represents Milwaukee's south shore, St. Francis and Cudahy.

officials.name: Gwen Moore
officials.notes: Re-elected Nov. 3, 2026. Mostly federal news; run only items that directly affect Bay View.

officials.name: Cavalier Johnson
officials.notes: Accounts confirmed from the city website footer. Citywide news only when it directly affects Bay View.

officials.name: David Crowley
officials.notes: Elected governor Nov. 3, 2026 (inauguration Jan. 4, 2027). When he resigns, Board Chair Marcelia Nicholson-Bovell becomes acting county executive and appoints an interim; special election in spring 2027. Update this entry then.

officials.name: Steven Shea
officials.covers: southeast edge of Bay View (city wards 287 and 288)

officials.name: Sylvia Ortiz-Velez
officials.covers: west edge of Bay View (near I-43 and S. 1st St.)
officials.notes: Lost the Aug. 11, 2026 primary; serves until January 2027. Replace with Ismael Luna then.

officials.name: Ismael Luna
officials.notes: Won Nov. 3, 2026; takes office January 2027. Add his official legislature page then.

officials.name: Tim Carpenter
officials.covers: west edge of Bay View (same area as Assembly District 8)

officials.name: Jessie Rodriguez
officials.covers: S. Howell Ave. at and south of Morgan (Gingerz, Golden Honey, Wioletta's, Gold Rush Chicken)
officials.notes: Retiring; Dan Bukiewicz (Oak Creek mayor) won the seat Nov. 3, 2026 and takes office January 2027 (campaign Facebook: BukiewiczForAssembly).

officials.name: Scott Spiker
officials.covers: S. Howell Ave. south of Morgan only
